Description: Uncovered a GCP API key, which could lead to unauthorized access to Google Cloud services and data breaches.
Author: Ahshika
Message:
Order Ly 1.0.4: cafe POS with QR self-ordering

Flutter (Windows + Android) cafe system with a local server on the
cashier PC and a Firebase-hosted customer menu:

- QR menu (Arabic/English): modifiers, upsell, name + phone, payment
  by cash/card/wallet/InstaPay with transfer screenshot, live order
  status, call waiter, ask for bill, partial payment, rating.
- Cashier: table map, checks (move/merge/split, discount, service,
  tax), QR inbox with alerts, transfer confirmation, register shifts.
- Bar/kitchen display and automatic ticket printing per station.
- Recipe-based inventory with auto sold-out, purchases, suppliers,
  "received quantity" dialog; promotions; loyalty points.
- Reports: profit, peak hours, menu engineering, voids, feedback.
- Printable QR cards with cafe name/logo.
- Reliability: self-restarting server isolate, background isolates for
  backups/images, debounced refresh, freeze watchdog + logs.
- Tests: server, live Firebase end-to-end, restart, watchdog, visuals.
